title: From RSD to Clusters: A Parameter-Locked Test of Late-Time Structure Growth
abstract: Propagates redshift-space distortion (RSD) constraints on the effective gravitational coupling into parameter-locked predictions for galaxy cluster abundances under Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC). With no parameters fit to cluster data and high-z (CMB) normalization, the paper predicts a +6.4% total cluster excess vs. ΛCDM and a distinctive negative tilt in the redshift-distribution shape ratio R(z), providing sealed, falsifiable targets for eRASS1.
